name: Mecan River
blurb: Mecan River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.takeOut: Upper Dike Mecan River Fish Barrier Bypass Landing
sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.

sections.accessReview: The take-out is downstream of Germania Dam. The carry around the dam and eastern-refuge access must be resolved before enabling this map.
sections.routeReview: This section includes Germania (Lower) and needs a closer check of the landing or portage. Consult the agency guide and signed access; do not assume you can paddle through a dam.

notices.title: Germania Dam and refuge restrictions
notices.text: This section ends below Germania Dam; a usable portage has not been established. DNR closes the eastern refuge September 1–November 30 except for the specified gun/muzzleloader deer seasons, and prohibits motorboats including electric motors. Check the property map and current rules.
